notes.title: The price of the "Diptych
notes.notes:
Friends! 
All of you probably noticed that the price of the "Diptych" was not something that bit, but, let's face it, it was ready to eat alive!

In the very near future, this misunderstanding will be corrected and you will be able to purchase our virtual comic at an affordable price.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Everything is going according to plan
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
Work on the "Diptych" continues, and, as the poet said: "Everything is going according to plan." 

Of course, you can get acquainted with the stories that the "Diptych" tells yourself - our visual novel is the game embodiment of the comic book of the same name by Alexey Troshina. 

Our game is a great occasion for those who are already familiar with the "Diptych" to touch this charming and scary work once again, and for those who hear about it for the first time - to get acquainted. Believe me, the "Diptych" will not leave anyone indifferent.

notes.title: Guten Tag!
notes.notes:
We continue to introduce you to the characters of the "Diptych". 
The hero of the second story is called Murnau. He is a professional military man, has the rank of lieutenant and has been at the front for a long time. Too long ago… 
Murnau never leaves his smoking pipe and once loved to draw. But war can change habits…
Rich combat experience and military savvy allow Murnau to literally sense danger with his nose – when an air raid is followed by shelling, and when it is necessary to quickly place his soldiers in positions to repel a surprise attack. But war can bring surprises…
And one day Murnau and Medok will meet on the battlefield.
What will come of it?
Add the "Diptych" to the steam vishlist so that you don't miss anything!

notes.title: Work on the game incarnation of the "Diptych" is in full swing!
notes.notes:
In the meantime, we decided to introduce you to our heroes.
And so, let me introduce - Honey. Yes, the name is a bit strange. And no, that's not his real name. Before the war, he worked in an apiary, and when he joined the troops, the nickname quickly stuck to him. It stuck. It's like being smeared with honey. Got the joke, right?)
Medok, like many of his comrades, went to the front as a volunteer. 
He was very young–only sixteen years old when he had to face all the horrors of war…
By the way, Honey (Medka's) real name is not mentioned anywhere.
What do you think his name might be? Throw up options!
